scope: Read-only review of the bounded T2 R3 raw-path repair draft. No implementation, Builder/CLI dispatch, source/test/Git mutation, or external action.

ownership.scope_restriction: Only light_knowledge.py shared raw-path validation plus directly required regressions; no public API/schema/selection/merge/refresh semantic change.

requirements_review.requirement: Repair the exact raw symlink/.. normalization bypass in shared product path validation.
requirements_review.draft_evidence: Expected production edit is light_knowledge.py shared path validation; inspect supplied edges before normpath/resolve.

requirements_review.requirement: Cover same-target raw symlink/../ws and symlink targets whose real resolution differs from lexical normalized workspace.
requirements_review.draft_evidence: Explicit regressions for raw symlink/../ws with differing real resolution and same-target traversal.

requirements_review.requirement: Reject raw parent components while keeping safe normal absolute and relative .work paths usable.
requirements_review.draft_evidence: Draft explicitly permits rejecting raw .. and requires normal absolute/relative .work paths.

requirements_review.requirement: Propagate refusal through all batch/refresh APIs, listing/blocker reads, and output helpers, with no state/output mutation.
requirements_review.draft_evidence: Draft names all API classes and requires closed refusals plus unchanged plans/HEAD/notes/outputs and existing output sentinels.

requirements_review.requirement: Preserve R2 complete-inventory, zero-refresh, ancestry, merge and finalization behavior.
requirements_review.draft_evidence: Draft explicitly says preserve all R2 tests and only repair raw-path class.

requirements_review.requirement: Produce cumulative evidence with all eight owned source/test copies, including unchanged light_backup.py.
requirements_review.draft_evidence: Evidence clarification explicitly requires eight R3 files and one byte-exact counterpart per handoff row.

requirements_review.requirement: Use COMMON exact-source four-file suite with absolute test paths, config/rootdir/pythonpath, module __file__, interpreter, cwd, hashes and actual result.
Remain a draft pending Root freeze, exact prompt, informed authorization and explicit dispatch.
requirements_review.draft_evidence: Final paragraph says this is not dispatch and Root will freeze/dispatch.

concrete_gaps_to_close_before_dispatch.finding: Freeze/prompt must bind the exact eight R2 source/test hashes and explicitly require cumulative R3 copies for all eight. The draft gives the snapshot hash and policy but no per-path hash table.
concrete_gaps_to_close_before_dispatch.required_action: Freeze from the exact R2 handoff rows and make all eight R3 file-copy rows mandatory; reject a handoff with only changed-file copies.

concrete_gaps_to_close_before_dispatch.finding: The output-helper requirement is scoped but not enumerated into a concrete test matrix.
concrete_gaps_to_close_before_dispatch.required_action: Prompt should name require_product_workspace and require_work_output plus at least one public output-producing API; assert refusal and unchanged sentinel bytes for each raw symlink/.. form.

concrete_gaps_to_close_before_dispatch.finding: “Normal relative .work paths usable” and “reject raw ..” can be read ambiguously for relative paths containing parent components.
concrete_gaps_to_close_before_dispatch.required_action: Freeze the exact rule: plain relative `.work/ws` remains usable; any supplied raw `..` component at product boundaries is refused, with closed status and no mutation.

concrete_gaps_to_close_before_dispatch.finding: The draft says check supplied and resolved `.work` boundaries but does not state the order for non-existent output parents or external symlink targets.
concrete_gaps_to_close_before_dispatch.required_action: Prompt should require raw component inspection before normalization, then resolved-boundary checks, for existing and non-existing output paths and both inside/outside symlink targets.

out_of_scope_confirmations: Do not change complete live inventory/partition binding.
Do not change refresh seed/delta/ancestry semantics.
Do not change merge/finalization/completion or backup classification semantics except path-refusal propagation.
Do not modify CLI, Skill, schemas, other lanes, Git, CI, PR, real Vault/admin or human-gate state.
